_note: THE FIVE ESSAYS. Built by scripts/build-essays.mjs into public/_pages/v3/stories/<slug>.html, routed at /stories/<slug>, and listed by the Written band on /stories. The prose lives in content/essay/*.html (the original WordPress export) and content/essay/_index.json (title, byline, date, original URL). Copy about the essays lives here.
_owner_ruling: PUBLISH THEM. UNSOURCED DATA IS ALLOWED OTHER THAN ON SITUATION PAGES (owner, 22 August 2026). This reverses the gate added earlier the same day, which refused to publish a story that carried no source. The reasoning that gate was built on still holds for the six situation pages — every figure there is asserted against a committed dataset and checked by npm run verify:final — and it does NOT extend to signed essays. An essay is a person's argument, dated and attributed; a situation page is the organisation's measurement. Different claims, different standards. So build-stories-page.mjs no longer demands a source per essay, and build-essays.mjs demands PROVENANCE instead: a byline, a date, and a link to where it first appeared.
_why_these_five: They are the organisation's own bylined long-form writing, so publishing them is a re-host and not a new claim. Found in the legacy crawl (docs/design/2026-08-22-LEGACY-SITE-CONTENT-AUDIT.md §1.3), which listed six. The sixth, 'Learning to grow with Swechha' (2018-07-24), is 397 words and carries no byline, so it is not one of these: the other five run 769-1264 words and each names its author. It is left out rather than counted to reach six.
_no_illustrations: THE ORIGINALS' IMAGES ARE NOT RE-HOSTED, AND THAT IS NOT A CHOICE ABOUT DESIGN. Every in the WordPress export points at http://q7s.734.mytemp.website/ — a staging domain the legacy audit found across the old site, which 301s to nothing; the swechha.in rewrite of the same paths 404s. Verified 22 August 2026. They also carry empty alt text, so even recovered they would fail the accessibility checks every other page here passes. The essays are text-led and read whole without them.
_prose_is_extracted_not_inlined: The WordPress export is Brizy page-builder markup — 502 divs, 204 spans, inline <style> blocks and data-brz-* attributes across the five files. It cannot be inlined into this design. The generator extracts the paragraphs, headings and lists in document order and re-emits clean semantic HTML, and a gate compares the extracted word count against the source so a silent loss of prose fails the build.

band.head: Written

band._hole_AD28: The `hole` here — 'The illustrations that ran with these essays are not here: they were served from a staging domain that no longer resolves' — is deleted under AD-28 §2.3. An essay with no illustration simply has no illustration. The reason is recorded in _no_illustrations above, which is where a finding belongs.
